decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system builds directly on the firm's core spraying and mixing know-how, so its own R&D can interpret field feedback and keep refining it for harsh-environment coating applications.

The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to the established injection and construction-repair business and has a dedicated web page, so related knowledge and customer access make it easy to absorb learning and improve it.

Fire protection flow monitoring extends into sensing and digital monitoring, which is less familiar, but it supports the digitalization strategy and benefits from university cooperation, so the firm keeps building knowledge rather than exiting early.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is close to the firm's established offer and was only launched in 2024, so its strong related knowledge base allows it to learn from early results and refine the product.
